verdict.rationale: Privacy controls such as opting out of usage tracking or analytics are a fair question for a SaaS spend-management platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry, analytics, tracking opt-outs or privacy settings. The only nearby item is check payments keeping bank details private, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
